- Hollow, rotted interior exposed by the split stem
- Completely wilted/dead plant with brown dried leaves
- Pulled from sandy soil showing root system

The reference image confirms **Southern Blight**: same white cottony mycelial growth on the stem base at the root crown, plant pulled from soil with root system exposed.
